status: Private stage frozen; production integration and shared full regression pending
limitations: Current Windows handle-backed implementation; other operating systems fail closed.
Runtime-only workspace provenance: preexisting/forked/restarted rows are unbound and cannot open workspace/apps links.
Native UI has no trusted per-message tab snapshot yet and rejects tab links. Resolver supports matching browser session plus allowed live IDs, or recorded http(s) historical fallback.
Attachment UI previews supported text encodings in a separate read-only tab; binary/image/PDF/archive viewers are not part of this slice.
Legacy aliases parse in resolver, but the existing Markdown scheme allowlist does not yet emit all of them. Shell links remain unsupported.
Source line suffix and query parameters are retained by resolver; the pinned UI also drops the parsed line number before opening. Native expanded-media UI remains unimplemented.
Link creation requires accessible current attachment storage and every configured mount; an unavailable mount may prevent other link actions in that scope.
20 MiB file preview bound, configurable only by host up to 64 MiB; bytes are a bounded capture, not an atomic snapshot during concurrent in-place writes.
Scope options and per-message provenance must be supplied only from trusted host/session state; a lease is checked against its chat, not a caller-supplied data-directory string.
Workspace Action holds non-delete-sharing handles only through synchronous editor load; retaining it through saving would block atomic replacement.
No user files, API credentials, or external service actions used. Loopback provider fixtures only.
